topic_title: Dangers of Speed and Street Racing Statutes
prompt: What penalty applies if an illegal street racing collision results in the death of any person?

options.text: Second-degree felony punishable by 2 to 20 years in prison and up to $10,000 fine
Class C misdemeanor settled by paying a five-hundred-dollar traffic fine
Probation with mandatory attendance at a thirty-day automotive driving course
Administrative suspension of commercial driver license endorsements for one year
